hero.title: Quality & Certificates
hero.intro: Every batch of Ankur Salt is tested and verified before it leaves our plants. Here's exactly how we refine it, and what each of our certifications actually means.

process.heading: Manufacturing Process
process.subheading: From raw salt to your table: six steps, the same way every time.

steps.title: Sourcing
steps.description: Raw salt is sourced from our own fields on India's marine salt belt in Gandhidham, Gujarat, near Kandla and Mundra ports.

steps.title: Washing & Crushing
steps.description: Raw crystals are picked clean of foreign particles, washed with magnetic separation to remove metal fragments, and centrifuged to separate pure brine before crushing brings every crystal to a uniform size.

steps.title: Refining
steps.description: Fully automated machinery based on Swiss technology refines the salt, drying it in a fluidised bed drier at a controlled 170°C to 260°C to reach purity greater than 98% NaCl.

steps.title: Iodisation
steps.description: Iodine is added and mixed to a controlled 20 ppm to 30 ppm content, monitored continuously so every batch stays within range.

steps.title: Quality Testing
steps.description: Before packaging, salt passes through a final screening stage where an 8mm screen and magnetic separator catch any oversized or metallic particles, then our in house QC lab runs more than 12 additional tests on every batch.

steps.title: Packaging & Dispatch
steps.description: Once cleared, the salt is sealed, stacked and loaded for dispatch to distributors, retailers and export markets around the world.

certifications.heading: Certifications Explained
certifications.subheading: What each certification actually means, not just a logo on a page.

items.name: ISO 22000-2018
items.description: Means our processes, from sourcing to packaging, are consistently managed and audited to meet an international quality standard, not checked just once.

items.name: FSSC 22000
items.description: One of the most widely recognised food safety certifications globally. It confirms our food safety practices meet standards accepted by retailers and food businesses worldwide.

items.name: BIS IS:7224
items.description: The Indian government's official specification for edible common salt. Meeting it means our salt meets India's defined standards for purity and safety.

items.name: FSSAI
items.issuer: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
items.description: India's food safety regulator. Our FSSAI license means we are registered, inspected and authorised to manufacture and sell food grade salt in India.

items.name: Halal Certified
items.description: Confirms our manufacturing process meets Islamic dietary requirements, verified by an accredited certifying body, important for many of our export markets.
